finding.title: Improper Input Validation
finding.assumptions: The elapsedTimeSeconds is derived from user-controlled input or is not properly validated.

finding.title: Improper Randomness
finding.trigger: The random number generator is seeded with the current time, which can be predictable.
finding.assumptions: The code does not use cryptographic randomness, but rather a simple time-based seed.

finding.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
finding.trigger: If damagePerTick is large enough, it could cause integer overflow when cast to int.
finding.assumptions: damagePerTick values are not properly validated or capped.

finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If elapsedTimeSeconds is derived from user-controlled input, it could be manipulated to inject special elements.
finding.assumptions: elapsedTimeSeconds is not user-controlled, but this is a potential issue if user input affects it indirectly.
